name: feature_delay
text:
A feature is taking longer than anticipated.

Push the team to hit the projected timeline?

Pushed the team to hit the deadline.

Staff retention decreased.

Partner retention held steady.
no_response:
Allowed delay.

Staff retention increased, partner growth and retention slightly decreased.

no_response:

text:

Prioritized the feature.

text:

Prioritize back-end improvements?

no_response:
Ignored risks – built a new feature.

Prioritize it?

text:

no_response:

text:

no_response:

text:

name: support_requests_taking_long
text:

no_response:
Ignored issue diagnosis and resolution.

text:

Do you want your team to rest and recover, instead of immediately pushing forward?

Your team rested and regained their energy.

no_response:
Pushed forward!
